Review of parse_network (request_changes): The current implementation of comment handling is incorrect. The spec states that comment lines are those 'whose first non-blank character is #'. Your code currently treats any line containing a '#' as having a comment (via `line.split('#', 1)`), which would incorrectly truncate valid data if a '#' appeared elsewhere. Please update the logic to only skip lines that start with '#' after stripping leading whitespace.
